locator.identity_review: The page that carries the coordinate names the facility address as 333 Diamond Drive NW, Huntsville, Alabama 35806, and DC BLOX's 28 September 2018 opening release places the opened Huntsville data center at the same address. The U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder matches 333 DIAMOND DR NW, HUNTSVILLE, AL 35806 on the Diamond Drive NW segment (TIGER line 58199777, address range 399 to 283) and assigns it to 2020 census block 010890014031026 (31.7 ha of land) in Huntsville city, Madison County; the Census coordinates endpoint places the operator's point in the same block. The Census interpolated point lies 262 m due south of the operator's point on the same street alignment. It is an interpolation along the 283 to 399 address range and does not mark a building, so it confirms the street, block, place and county but not the operator point's position along Diamond Drive NW; it is a cross-check, not the locator. No official Huntsville or Madison County parcel or address service was reachable within robots rules (the City map server disallows query URLs; the county host returned HTTP 403 to robots.txt). No OpenStreetMap feature, city centroid or county centroid is used.
